newsitem.title: USA: Bandag says franchisees might sell business.
newsitem.headline: Bandag says franchisees might sell business.

text.p: Bandag Inc, a manufacturer of tread rubber and tire retreading equipment, said Tuesday it has been informed that owners of franchises representing about four percent of revenues have entered negotiations to sell substantial interests to a new entity.
Bandag said it could not predict the extent of any distribution that would be lost as a result of the proposed sales or the impact of any lost distribution on its sales and earnings.
If the sale is completed, the four franchisees are expected to become minority shareholders in the new entity, Bandag said.

Bandag said that it has told the franchisees that based on its understanding of the proposed transaction, Bandag does not intend to transfer ownership of the current franchises to the new entity. The four companies currently operate 36 Bandag franchises.
